thesis: The bear carries the case for waiting on a new purchase, because current negative FCF and rising debt are more directly observed than the projected investment payoff. This supports a neutral watch stance; it does not establish structural demand deterioration.
strongest_counterexample: Comparable revenue grew 24.65% and the latest operating margin exceeded its year-ago observation, so demand and operating earning power remain substantial while the market has repriced the stock.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy after two consecutive reported quarters of positive FCF with total debt no higher than the current observation.
Reconsider toward sell after two consecutive reported quarters of revenue decline and operating margin below the current reported level.
evidence_gaps: Cash returns and financing needs of the investment program.
Authenticated valuation after separating non-operating investment effects.
Complete debt maturity and interest-coverage context.
decisive_factors: Two consecutive negative quarterly FCF observations.
Debt increased across the supplied history.
No confirmed price repair or authenticated valuation discount.
